summary: Implemented the reusable trajectory-promotion contract: canonical workload signatures and JSON manifests, stable regional inventories/digests, digest-checked runtime resolution with explicit eager fallback reasons, request-owned named checkpoint capture, structural/numerical/task-level trajectory gates, and DenoisingStage acceptance of a resolved regional compile plan. Unit and synthetic ROCm GPU validation passed. This is a framework candidate, not a promoted production-model plan.

tests.what_was_measured: 18 unit tests covering stable serialization/hashing, supported and unsupported resolution, revision/state/digest fallback, rejected manifests, immutable capture snapshots, missing checkpoints, shape/decision/terminal invariants, per-step perturbation localization, separate output metrics, stable region inventory, and denoising eager fallback. Raw output: reports/j-ca997a4b410d/raw/unit_tests.log

Real torch.compile/Inductor execution on one AMD Instinct MI350X using an independent eager reference over a four-step stateful trajectory; cold compile+rollout 2.549s, warm rollout 1.125ms, max per-step absolute error 1.1921e-7, reset/two-step history passed, and an intentional step-1 perturbation was rejected at the first changed checkpoint. Raw output: reports/j-ca997a4b410d/raw/gpu_trajectory_gate.log
Python syntax/import byte-compilation and whitespace validity. Ruff was unavailable in the prepared interpreter and on PATH.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; real Inductor compilation and eager-versus-compiled numerical trajectory evidence retained in reports/j-ca997a4b410d/raw/gpu_trajectory_gate.log

remaining_limitations: No production diffusion or stateful world-model weights were supplied, so this PR does not promote any concrete model/workload manifest and does not claim semantic image/video/action quality.
Cache-DiT on/off, CFG serial/parallel, distributed topology, and model-specific reset/history regimes remain to be validated by model adapters before their signatures may be marked validated.

The generic resolver is implemented and DenoisingStage accepts its resolved plan, but server configuration/CLI loading and request/server fallback counters are not wired in this candidate; callers must load and resolve the offline manifest and pass the resolution.
Graph-count, graph-break, recompile, peak-memory, and p50/p95 collection are not yet implemented in an offline promotion runner.
Mutation safety here clones captured tensors; model-specific custom operations that mutate cache buffers still require correct mutation/alias metadata and model integration tests.
No native C++ or FlyDSL source was changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
Ruff is not installed in the prepared environment; compileall, git diff --check, and focused pytest coverage were used instead.
